name: Delbert Ray Fulkerson
summary: Pioneering mathematician in operations research, network flow theory, and combinatorial analysis.

name: Elbert Fulkerson
summary: High school principal and mathematics teacher at Southern Illinois University; father of Delbert Ray Fulkerson.

name: Emma Fulkerson
summary: Mother of Delbert Ray Fulkerson.

name: George Dantzig
summary: Mathematician who moved to Rand Corporation from the Air Force in 1952; collaborator with Fulkerson.

name: Selmer Johnson
summary: Mathematician and collaborator with Fulkerson and Dantzig on the traveling salesman problem.

name: Lester R. Ford, Jr.
summary: Mathematician and collaborator with Fulkerson on network flows and mathematical programming.

name: Alan Hoffman
summary: Close friend and professional colleague of Fulkerson who spoke at his memorial service.

name: Louis J. Billera
summary: Co-author of the Cornell University Faculty Memorial Statement for Fulkerson.

name: William F. Lucas
summary: Co-author of the Cornell University Faculty Memorial Statement for Fulkerson.

name: Robert E. Bechhofer
summary: Co-author of the Cornell University Faculty Memorial Statement for Fulkerson.

name: Guy Emmet Fulkerson
summary: Son of Delbert Ray Fulkerson, residing in La Jolla, California at time of father's death.

name: Lee Alan Fulkerson
summary: Son of Delbert Ray Fulkerson, residing in Santa Monica, California at time of father's death.

name: Eleanor Fulkerson
summary: Former wife of Delbert Ray Fulkerson, residing in Santa Monica, California at time of his death.

name: Merle Guthrie
summary: Sister of Delbert Ray Fulkerson, residing in Belleville, Illinois at time of his death.

name: June Todd
summary: Sister of Delbert Ray Fulkerson, residing in Skokie, Illinois at time of his death.

name: Richard Fulkerson
summary: Brother of Delbert Ray Fulkerson, residing in Commerce, Texas at time of his death.

name: Glen Fulkerson
summary: Brother of Delbert Ray Fulkerson, residing in San Diego, California at time of his death.

name: Tamms
summary: Town in Illinois where Delbert Ray Fulkerson was born.

name: Carterville
summary: Town in Illinois where Fulkerson attended grade school and high school.

name: Carbondale
summary: City in Illinois where Fulkerson's family moved and where his father taught at Southern Illinois University.

name: Southern Illinois University
summary: University in Carbondale, Illinois where Fulkerson's father taught and where Fulkerson enrolled in 1941.

name: University of Wisconsin
summary: University where Fulkerson received his M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in mathematics.

name: U.S. Army Air Corps
summary: Military branch where Fulkerson served as a meteorologist from 1942 to 1946.

name: Rand Corporation
summary: Research corporation in Santa Monica, California where Fulkerson worked for over twenty years starting in 1951.

name: University of California, Los Angeles
summary: University where Fulkerson taught the first course in network flow theory in 1958.

name: University of California, Berkeley
summary: University where Fulkerson was visiting professor in 1963.

name: Stanford University
summary: University where Fulkerson was visiting professor in 1966.

name: University of Waterloo
summary: Canadian university where Fulkerson was distinguished visitor in 1968 and visiting professor in 1971.

name: Cornell University
summary: University where Fulkerson joined as Maxwell M. Upson Professor of Engineering in fall 1971.

name: Operations Research Society of America
summary: Professional society that awarded the Lanchester Prize; Fulkerson was a member at time of death.

name: Mathematical Association of America
summary: Professional society that gave the Lester R. Ford Award; Fulkerson was a member and edited a collection for them.

name: Mathematical Programming Society
summary: Professional society where Fulkerson was a council member and associate editor of its journal.

name: American Mathematical Society
summary: Professional society of which Fulkerson was a member at time of death.

name: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics
summary: Professional society of which Fulkerson was a member at time of death.

name: Institute of Management Sciences
summary: Professional society of which Fulkerson was a member at time of death.

name: Flows in Networks
summary: Classic book on network flows by Ford and Fulkerson, published in 1962.

name: Lanchester Prize
summary: Award given by the Operations Research Society of America; Fulkerson received honorable mention twice.

name: Lester R. Ford Award
summary: Award given by the Mathematical Association of America; Fulkerson received it in 1967.
